title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.26995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. translated_title: SPEM：面向LLM智能体高效技能使用的结构感知程序性记忆
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体日益依赖可复用的技能。然而，随着技能库的扩展，高效且准确地使用技能变得困难。完整加载技能会带来高昂的token和运行时开销；相比之下，扁平的语义检索将技能视为独立的文本条目，忽略了技能间的依赖关系、执行顺序、状态转换和数据流约束。我们提出SPEM，一个轻量级的结构感知程序性记忆框架，用于LLM智能体的高效技能使用。SPEM维护用于单个技能的原子技能记忆，以及从成功执行中提炼出的可复用组合的Skill-DAG记忆。对于新任务，若存在高置信度的Skill-DAG模板，SPEM会直接复用；否则，它将检索原子技能并调用Skill-GNN进行状态和结构感知的技能选择。成功的执行会作为新的Skill-DAG写回记忆，使程序性记忆能够随时间不断积累。在ALFWorld和Sk……上的实验（摘要截断）
tldr: SPEM提出一种轻量级结构感知的程序性记忆框架，通过原子技能记忆、Skill-DAG组合模板和Skill-GNN实现LLM智能体高效准确的技能选择与复用，并从成功执行中持续积累记忆。
en_tdlr: SPEM is a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework that combines atomic skill memory, reusable Skill-DAG templates, and a Skill-GNN to enable efficient and accurate skill selection and reuse in LLM agents while accumulating memory from successful executions.
